# agentlytics by measuremy.site

Website analytics your AI agent can read, explain and act on.

Add one script tag. See every traffic spike, where it came from and why. Then let your coding agent turn it into a marketing plan, ship it with tracked links and measure what worked.

## Stop reading dashboards. Ask your agent what to do next.

agentlytics measures your site, explains what moved it, and gives your coding agent the tools to act on it.

### Track

A 1 KB cookieless script records pageviews, referrers, UTM tags and the events you care about, like signups and purchases.

### Understand

Spikes are detected every hour against the same hour in past weeks. Each one shows the source, page and event that drove it, with an AI summary.

### Grow

Your agent connects over MCP, plans marketing from what already worked, creates tracked links for what it ships, and checks the results.

## Every spike, explained.

When traffic jumps, you see why in seconds: which referrer, which landing page, which conversions, and what you shipped the day before.

- Compared with your own normal. Each hour is measured against the same hour of the week, so Monday mornings don't look like spikes.

- Causes ranked by lift. Sources, pages and events, each with its share of the extra traffic.

- Context included. Launches, posts and deploys you log show up next to the spike they caused.

## Your agent plans it, ships it and measures it.

The same agent that writes your code can now run growth: it reads what worked, drafts the next post, tags every link it publishes and reports back.

- Tracked links by default. Every post, email or ad gets its own campaign, so results are never guesswork.

- Actions ranked by evidence. Suggestions come from your real channels and conversion rates, not generic advice.

## What your agent gets

A focused set of tools over the Model Context Protocol. Each read key is scoped to a single site.

Visitors, pageviews and change vs the previous period

Every unusual jump, compared with the same hour in past weeks

The sources, pages and events behind a spike, ranked

Ask about visits: filter by country, browser, OS, source or page, and group the counts

The latest individual visits, with where they came from and what they used

Where visitors are from, plus top_browsers and top_systems for what they use

Channels ranked by conversions and growth

A ranked action list built from your own numbers

A tracked link for every post, email or ad your agent ships

What each campaign actually brought in

Log launches, posts and deploys so spikes have context

Publish a public dashboard, or turn it off, when you ask

## Live in two minutes

Paste one sentence into your coding agent. It signs you up with a code from your email, adds the snippet to your project and connects itself. Or do it by hand on Next.js, React, Astro, WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Ghost, Google Tag Manager and Plain HTML.

### Add your site

Your agent asks for your email and domain, or sign up yourself. No password, no card.

### Paste one tag

The snippet goes in your site's <head> . It also proves you own the domain.

<script defer src="https://a.measuremy.site/t.js" data-key="pk_…"></script>

### Connect your agent

One command for Claude Code, a config file for Cursor and Codex.

claude mcp add --transport http \ agentlytics https://a.measuremy.site/mcp

## Useful numbers, no surveillance

### No cookies

Nothing is stored in your visitors' browsers, so there's no consent banner to add for us.

### No personal data

IP addresses are never stored. Visitors are counted with a hash that changes every day.

### Your domain only

Sites are verified before anything is recorded, and each read key sees one site.

### Bots filtered

Crawlers, previews and headless browsers are dropped before they reach your numbers.

## Questions

No. The dashboard shows traffic, spikes with their causes, campaigns and suggested actions. The agent connection is there when you want it to do the work.

Any client that speaks MCP over HTTP. Setup is one command for Claude Code and a short config file for Cursor and Codex. See the agent guide .

When the snippet is live on your homepage, the first visit verifies it automatically. If you load it through a tag manager, add a DNS TXT record instead. Nothing is recorded until then.

New visits stop being recorded until next month or until you upgrade, and everything you've already collected stays available. You'll see a warning at 80%, and there are never surprise overage charges. Above 2M pageviews a month, contact us for a custom plan.

Raw visits are kept for 400 days. Hourly totals and detected spikes are kept for as long as you have an account. Free accounts that nobody has used for three months (no login and no agent use) are deleted with their data, after an email warning two weeks in advance.
